## PR description
### [BugFix][Ming-TTS] Improve Seed-TTS WER accuracy  [labels: ready, tts]
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Purpose

Align Ming-TTS generation/eval behavior with the HF path to improve Seed-TTS WER accuracy, including Ming instruction handling, audio VAE latent path, stop-head gating, and benchmark PCM sample-rate parsing.

## Test Plan

**vLLM Version:** 0.24.0

**vLLM-Omni Commit:** this PR, tested on current branch based on `0455bffc3768e1fe616fea37885fb0a84cd5985b`

```bash
vllm-omni serve /home/admin/model \
  --deploy-config /vllm-workspace/vllm-omni/vllm_omni/deploy/ming_tts_moe.yaml \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --omni
```

```bash
export SEED_TTS_EVAL_DEVICE=cuda:0
export SEED_TTS_HF_WHISPER_MODEL=/home/admin/whisper-large-v3
export SEED_TTS_SIM_EVAL=0
export SEED_TTS_UTMOS_EVAL=0
export VLLM_OMNI_BENCH_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE=44100
export VLLM_OMNI_BENCH_AUDIO_CHANNELS=1

vllm bench serve --omni \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 \
  --model /home/admin/model \
  --backend openai-audio-speech \
  --endpoint /v1/audio/speech \
  --dataset-name seed-tts \
  --dataset-path /home/admin/seedtts_data \
  --seed-tts-locale en \
  --num-prompts 1088 \
  --num-warmups 0 \
  --max-concurrency 1 \
  --request-rate inf \
  --seed-tts-wer-eval \
  --save-result
```
